mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods with declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in > 60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling a slowdown in economic activity and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 90.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 360,000 and HOUST > 540,000 in same month
failure_condition: The joint spike in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 215.0 signals an active monetary tightening cycle amid inflationary pressures, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during co-triggered FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 215.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.0%), signals labor market weakening, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 50,000 and UNRATE > 9.0% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized rate, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220), signals a strong late-cycle expansion with robust corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The co-occurrence of GDPC1 > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL < 220 fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
